description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [ATK and DEF +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Awoken Forbidden Power], [Damage Cap +10000], [Quad Element Mode (Fire, Earth, Wind, Water)] and [Chosen Ninja Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Forbidden Power
description.text: Celerity and Ninja abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Celerity and Ninja abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Quad Element Mode (Fire, Earth, Wind, Water)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Earth]/[Attach Wind]/[Attach Water] after using a Fire/Earth/Wind/Water ability

description.name: Chosen Ninja Mode
description.text: Grants [Fire, Earth, Wind, Water Ability +10% Boost 1]/[Fire, Earth, Wind, Water Ability +30% Boost 1]/[Fire, Earth, Wind, Water +50% Boost 1] to all allies after using 2/4/6+2n Celerity or Ninja abilities
